summary: Western Copper & Gold Corp filed a Form 6-K containing condensed interim consolidated financial statements for the quarter ended March 31, 2026, along with management's discussion and analysis and CEO/CFO certifications. The filing is a routine periodic report by a Canadian foreign private issuer, with no special-situation event such as a merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or abrupt management change. The financial statements show a net loss of C$2.5 million for the quarter and an increase in cash and short-term investments to C$134 million, primarily from financing activities including a C$92 million equity issuance and associated costs. No deal terms apply.
